findings.detail: not a git repository, so commit order cannot be verified. This is reported as a SKIP rather than a PASS: the sealing claim rests on `git log`, and without a repo there is no evidence either way.

evidence.how_to_make_it_real: git init; git add grammar/ config/ docs/ sim/schema.py; git commit -m 'grammar + sealed manifest, before any modelling'; then git add features/ gate/ and commit separately. See README section 'Making the seal real'.

findings.detail: all 24 families derive distinct KDF-derived RNG streams

evidence.why: Separate streams are what make adding a training campaign unable to shift a held-out family's draws. With one global generator, 'held out' would silently become 'generated from a state the training data determined'.

findings.detail: every resolved label arrived within the window and after its own event
43+ entity ids are shared between the training rows and holdout-family rows across 3 key types

evidence.why_it_matters: Withholding the label while training on the same device node is not a holdout. The aggregate carries the information even when no row crosses the boundary.

findings.detail: cohort baselines, quantile edges and cold-start priors were fitted causally on the training window with holdout-family rows excluded

evidence.exclusions_note: The features listed above are structural graph or modal-comparison properties rather than time series. They are NOT strictly point-in-time, and the exclusion is listed here so it is auditable rather than discovered.

reference_stats.causality_note: Fitted on the TRAINING WINDOW ONLY with holdout-family rows excluded, then frozen and applied forward. eval/leakage/statistic_fit.py asserts it.

strict_causality_exclusions.acceptor_descriptor_mismatch: compares against the acceptor's MODAL descriptor over its history
strict_causality_exclusions.sketch_address_node_density: structural graph property, not a time series
strict_causality_exclusions.sketch_device_shared_entity_count: structural graph property, not a time series
strict_causality_exclusions.sketch_fingerprint_collision_degree: structural graph property, not a time series
strict_causality_exclusions.traffic_geo_vs_registered_geo: compares against the acceptor's MODAL geo cell over its history
strict_causality_exclusions.txn_note_template_score: compares against the payee's MODAL transaction note

findings.detail: no feature name, detector config or rule string references a held-out family id

policy: Any FAIL fails the build. A SKIPPED-UNVERIFIABLE is reported as a skip and never counted as a pass — a pass we did not earn would be the most misleading line in the whole report.
